coverage.sample_weighting: Uniform sample without replacement among roster indices 100 and above, excluding 3097.
coverage.depth: Round 0 for all tested starts. A round 1 stage is counted only if funded under that law.
coverage.phase_coloring: Stage involutions need not preserve birth round. An action is traced across rounds only if it preserves the initial knot set and moves an initial knot.
coverage.state_laws: Even parity and not-all-equal at every knot. Read each funded stage under its own growth law.

conventions.actions: Count all involutive incidence permutations with a nonidentity knot action. Distinction permutations act on values without sign changes.
conventions.representation: The ordered lift matches sorted identifiers between exchanged holder classes and fixes each distinction in invariant holder classes. Each entry records a representative and its exact multiplicity; the ordered lift contributes once whether or not its class also includes other lifts.
conventions.multiplicity: Across exchanged holder classes of size m, count m! bijections. Within an invariant class count m! / ((m-2t)! 2^t t!) for t transpositions, since relabellings conjugate all such lifts. Initial distinctions are kept explicit when a lift preserves birth round.
conventions.complement_fixed: An allowed state whose image under the distinction permutation equals its bitwise complement.
conventions.state_count_sums: Sums over labelled allowed states, equally weighted within each supported incidence lift and then added across lifts with their multiplicities.
conventions.fixed_support: Fixed knots and fixed distinctions are recorded independently.
conventions.all_shared: Remove fixed knots. Retain every shared distinction with both holders among the moved knots.
conventions.moved_shared: Remove fixed knots and use only moved shared distinctions with both holders among moved knots.
conventions.partner_chain: A chain of shared distinctions joining a moved knot to its partner. The recorded shortest witness gives the length, knots, shared distinctions, and knot-pair representatives. A connected component without such a chain is exchanged with a different component.

post_read_full_replay.stage_inclusion: Every stage actually formed, even if growth stops there. Do not copy a terminal stage into later rounds.
